faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Mansa Family Court Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the application for the Mansa Family Court Recruitment 2026 is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for General Counsellor / Child Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 10 vacancies announced for the Mansa Family Court Recruitment 2026, comprising 6 posts for General Counsellor and 4 posts for Child Counsellor.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum age requirement for these posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement for both General Counsellor and Child Counsellor posts is 35 years. The age is to be considered as of 01 January 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for the Mansa Family Court jobs?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree from a recognized university, preferably with subjects like Social Science, Sociology, Psychology, Clinical Psychiatry, or Law, along with at least two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for this Mansa Family Court Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for these positions?
faq.answer: The application process for the Mansa Family Court Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Mansa Family Court Counsellor posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the General Counsellor and Child Counsellor posts will be based on an Interview/Interaction with the shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: The recruitment for the General Counsellor / Child Counsellor posts in Mansa Family Court is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the application form?
faq.answer: The application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Mansa Family Court, which is https://mansa.dcourts.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and experience certificates with the application form.
